responsibility: Implements pattern matching and rewriting on SLP trees after scalar statements have already been grouped for basic-block or loop-aware SLP vectorization. It inspects lane/load permutations and operand subtrees to recognize SLP-specific idioms such as complex-number operation layouts and add/sub or fused multiply-add/sub forms, validates target support through internal functions, and rewrites SLP nodes in place into pattern representatives that the SLP transformer can vectorize directly.
